title: PythonComponent
rules: code is the full Python source as one JSON string with escaped newlines.
Reference each input by its name as a variable; assign each output by its name. An unassigned output is null.
Do not use print to return results — assign to declared output variables.
Each input/output name is a valid Python identifier, unique within its list.
A typed input arrives already converted (type 'Point' -> Rhino.Geometry.Point3d). Omit type for any.
access: 'item' (single), 'list' (whole input as a Python list), or 'tree'.

example.code:
import Rhino.Geometry as rg

spheres = [rg.Sphere(pt, radius) for pt in pts]
